Title: Founder & CEO
Observation: Your pricing page lists three plans but there's no trial CTA above the fold
Problem: paid traffic lands, reads, and leaves without a next step — you pay for the click and get nothing back
Idea: one trial CTA above the fold plus a 3-email activation sequence for everyone who starts it

Title: Co-founder
Observation: Your Meta ads all point at the homepage rather than the product they show
Problem: the shopper has to find the product again after clicking, and most don't
Idea: route each ad to its own product page and rebuild the catalogue feed around your top 20 SKUs

Title: CEO
Observation: Your enquiry form promises a callback but there's no confirmation email after submitting
Problem: interest peaks at submission and cools before a counsellor calls — the best leads go quiet first
Idea: an instant confirmation with the counsellor's name and slot, then two reminders before the call
